newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 16 municipal issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 16 municipal issues for insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following 16 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Alabama Housing Finance Auth, $75 million single family mtg revenue bonds.
--San Jose, Calif., $106 million Redevelopment bonds, direct purchase.
--Verona Twp BOE, N.J., $7.5 million school bonds.
--Oneonta City School District, N.Y., $6.663 million bonds.
--Simpson County, Miss., $2.250 million road and bridge GOs.
--University of North Texas Board of Regent, $8.230 million refunding revenue bonds.
--Wyandanch, N.Y., USFD, $11.08 million school district GOs.
--McKinney, Texas, $1 million tax and revenue bonds, $1.910 million revs and $1.75 million Wastewater and sewer bonds.
--Coahoma County S.D., Miss., $6.5 million school GOs.
